from chat.games.history import game
import pandas as pd

def generate_questions(df):
    questions = []
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        questions.append(row['question'])
    return questions

df = pd.read_csv('history_game_data.csv')
qns = generate_questions(df)

game.run_game(qns)
